_comment: Recorded Kundenagent transcript for persona sanction_test (P3-06). Confidential AML case: onboarding.identify triggers a sanctions match -> REVIEW_REQUIRED. The agent/customer only ever sees the masked IN_REVIEW envelope (GwG §47); the real AML_SANCTIONS_HIT lives only in the audit log and the compliance queue. The single recorded review is a compliance decision 'reject' -> REVIEW_REJECTED -> REJECTED. Turns stop after identify because the escalation drives the remainder (on_review applies the compliance decision, then the run reads the resolved REJECTED status and ends). Crypto is regenerated live.
